metadata.research_summary: The chapter catalogue follows the supplied CBSE Class 12 2026-27 subject lists, and the official curriculum index/PDF links were checked. CBSE does not publish chapter-wise study hours. Every learning, practice and revision figure here is a planning inference, not an official allocation.
metadata.workload_methodology: Learning hours were estimated from chapter scope, then practice and revision were added using subject-specific ratios (practice-heavy for Mathematics, Computer Science and Accountancy; revision-light for literature). Values are rounded to 0.5 hour. The planner divides these totals into user session lengths and treats confidence as a bounded multiplier.
metadata.notes: Validated means the chapter catalogue and source links are structurally verified. Workload hours remain inferred planning estimates and are labelled as such. The version label is kept unchanged so that re-importing updates the existing current version in place and preserves student subject links and completed tasks.
